name: Observatory
description: A synthetic-only evidence package supporting the forthcoming paper Agent Culture as an Observation Problem. The package examines the declared-provenance scope rule in a deterministic Observatory prototype. It preserves the failed definitions1 baseline, corrected provenance1 implementation, matched authored controls, a frozen synthetic challenge, and a separate simulated application-integration follow-up. The challenge records 102 passing, 0 failing, 24 unsupported assertions. The integration follow-up records 257 PASS and 3 literal-label mismatch failures across 27 checkpoints. Original failures and unsupported outcomes remain preserved without retroactive rescoring. METR zero-candidate observations arose from regex nonrecognition; matched synthetic controls demonstrated the provenance gate. The package includes source code, synthetic fixtures, machine-readable results, hashes, licence/category mapping and reproduction instructions. Its synthetic review host is a separately identified packaging derivative with unchanged executable scripts. Original model captures are deferred to a possible v2. METR text, excerpts and PDF are excluded; quote-free historical summaries, locators and selection hashes remain included. The release preserves the frozen private-review evidence unchanged and adds the author-approved licensing layer as a separately versioned artifact.
